date_note: Date of the abnormal access attempt as stated by ETNews; the article was published 25 November (KST).
title: Korea Information & Communications (KICC) VAN says some merchant data leaked after unauthorized access, Daily Security reports
summary: Daily Security reports that KICC announced on 23 November a leak of some merchant and customer information after an unauthorized outside user accessed a merchant server on 20 November; the attacker's IP address was blocked. Per Daily Security the data includes merchant name, business registration number, representative's name, address and MID. ETNews, citing industry sources, also lists transaction numbers. KICC has not disclosed how many merchants were affected, according to Daily Security.
plain: Daily Security reports that KICC, a Korean payment network provider, announced a leak of some merchant and customer information after unauthorized access on 20 November.
exec: A Korean VAN payment provider announced a leak of some merchant data; Daily Security says it could be used for secondary fraud against merchants.

validation.note: ETNews and Daily Security (two publishers) state the access and leak; Daily Security relays KICC's 23 November notice; the notice itself was not read.

review.note: title, date 20 Nov, data fields, IP block against Daily Security and ETNews
